look: B&W collage reel copied from Sathya's reference video: lit grey paper wall with their halftone paper texture; their black-and-white sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; one flat accent per scene (red #C62A2A, blue #3E73B8); camera lives in a tall world and travels through it (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur, roll transitions), type sits in the world behind and around figures; Morven kicker above a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals; Regarn Black tapes and stamps; giant red numerals; hand-drawn red marks drawing on; glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, timed to the voice-over script.

scenes.name: Typing itself
scenes.desc: A bank login screen; the password types itself with no hands on the keys. THE BANK THINKS IT'S YOU.

scenes.name: The scoop
scenes.desc: Axios and Reuters headline cards slam onto the wall with an OCT 22 date stamp: US BANKS ARE BLOCKING AI.

scenes.name: Banks push back
scenes.desc: Three bank name plates: Morgan Stanley gets a BLOCKING stamp, JPMorgan and Citi get RESTRICTING.

scenes.name: The easy way
scenes.desc: A hand pastes a username and password into an AI chat box; the AI replies it will handle the rest.

scenes.name: Same login
scenes.desc: Split screen YOU vs AI AGENT logging in; identical login records stack up. SAME PASSWORD = SAME PERSON.

scenes.name: Approved or rogue
scenes.desc: Two identical agent silhouettes under a spotlight; one glitches red. The bank can't tell which is which.

scenes.name: Under your name
scenes.desc: The agent dials the support hotline while the transaction list moves on its own, every line signed with your name.

scenes.name: No passwords
scenes.desc: Three rules. Rule card 1: NO PASSWORDS, a key crossed out.

scenes.name: Read-only
scenes.desc: Rule card 2: READ-ONLY. A downloaded statement goes to the AI; it can see, but it can't move money.

scenes.name: Check weekly
scenes.desc: Rule card 3: CHECK WEEKLY, a calendar ticks through the weeks.

scenes.name: Keep the keys
scenes.desc: Back to the login screen: the cursor stops, the screen locks. DON'T HAND IT THE KEYS.
